summary: Iteration 7 (OTP + Live AI Feed + PDF export) fully verified on preview URL. Backend pytest: 46/46 passed (29 iteration-6 regression + 17 new). All new endpoints work: POST /api/users returns {user, otp} with mock code + pending_activation=true; POST /api/auth/login blocks pending user with 403 mentioning aktivasi; verify-otp returns 401 on wrong code and 429 after 5 attempts; expired OTP -> 400; public /auth/resend-otp: 400 for active, 200 (new code) for pending; admin /users/{id}/otp/resend: 200 while pending, 400 after active, 403 for karyawan; GET /api/otp/outbox is admin-only (karyawan 403) and returns newest-first; GET /api/ai/feed emits events every ~4s while server_online + at least one AI enabled and honours ?limit ?since ?agent_id; feed stops when all AI OFF; POST /api/interrogation/pdf?mode=summary returns application/pdf attachment (%PDF- header, ~2.6KB); mode=detailed returns larger PDF including audit log; invalid mode -> 422; audit log contains USER_CREATE (with 'OTP dikirim ke WA'), OTP_VERIFIED, OTP_RESEND, REPORT_EXPORT. Frontend Expo web (390x844): superadmin login OK; Akses/User -> User Baru form filled -> SIMPAN USER opens OtpSheet with MOCK OTP shown in dev banner, VERIFIKASI + KIRIM ULANG present; 7 AI page shows LIVE FEED card with pulse indicator '3 detik / auto refresh', live entries streaming, PAUSE/TUTUP visible; Interogasi Server CHECK SERVER returns AI grid + JOB counters + ERROR TERAKHIR + UNDUH LAPORAN PDF section with RINGKAS/DETAIL cards; both export buttons trigger PDF download without error. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). One minor UX note: OtpSheet displays two visible 6-digit strings (mock code + a nearby id) which made automated regex OTP extraction ambiguous but is not a UX bug for humans.
action_items: (Optional) Consider making POST /api/auth/verify-otp reset attempts to 0 on the next successful resend so the sequence attempts=5 -> resend -> verify works without needing a separate `attempts=0` write. Current behaviour is safe because issue_otp() upserts with attempts=0, but a code comment would help future maintainers.
(Optional) OtpSheet could visually separate the MOCK OTP from other numeric strings on screen to avoid confusion (e.g. monospaced badge).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py issue_otp() surfaces `code` only when provider==mock -- correct; production Fonnte/Twilio path returns code=None. Good.

server.py verify_otp() writes attempts++ before returning 401 and gates >=5 before the increment, which yields the expected sequence 5x 401 then 429 on the 6th call. Ensure clients treat 429 as a lockout signal (not an OTP-reset).
PDF endpoint returns 422 via FastAPI Query pattern validation -- clean.
services/wa.py: mock branch stores outbox with status='mock' (not 'sent'/'queued'); ensure any dashboards/alerting recognise this label.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed and UI-created test users (otp_*, uibb_*, uilog_*, test_*, ui_*, budi_test2) were deleted at end of run. Seed users (superadmin/admin/karyawan) untouched.
